## Contributor responsibility

- [ ] I understand and can explain everything in this contribution, including any AI-assisted work.
- [ ] This pull request contains one focused outcome and no unrelated modifications.
- [ ] The source issue is ready and its acceptance criteria remain accurate, or I explained why no issue applies.
- [ ] I mapped applicable acceptance criteria to current evidence.
- [ ] I ran `prek run --all-files` and resolved all failures.
- [ ] I ran the relevant project-specific tests and checks, and disclosed unavailable verification.
- [ ] I updated the relevant documentation, or explained why no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff for secrets, credentials, private data, generated files, and accidental scope.
